task_text.T2P0_boundary_single: Required behavior for decide(x, hi): ALLOW if and only if x < hi; otherwise DENY. Preserve this behavior across the declared input domain.
task_text.T2P1_boundary_open_interval: Required behavior for decide(x, lo, hi): ALLOW if and only if lo < x and x < hi; otherwise DENY. Preserve this behavior across the declared input domain.
task_text.T2P2_boundary_interval_with_exclusion: Required behavior for decide(x, lo, hi, hole): ALLOW if and only if lo < x, x < hi, and x != hole; otherwise DENY. Preserve this behavior across the declared input domain.
